_about: THE SEATED DRIVERS' SPLIT (tools/build_seated.py reads it; hand set, 2026-11-16). Per vehicle frame:
cut: the near door's top edge (Grandma's car) or the near sleigh wall's rim (the sleigh), a polyline in DESKTOP ATLAS PX of the frame
(3.2 px per road px, its top left corner); the front layer is the vehicle's own pixels below this line, inside its x span, for
band road px down (deep enough to cover the driver's hidden part at every lean). The phone tier uses the same line in road px.
snap: [x0, x1] desktop px: between them each column's cut moves to the top of the dark ink line within snapPx of the hand line
(so the door's or the rim's outline belongs to the front layer); dark = the ink's brightness limit.
figure: where the driver's locked still sits. pivot: the still's hip point (its own px, the 1254 canvas); at: road px from the
vehicle's anchor (the frame's bottom centre) where the pivot lands; height: the still's trimmed height in road px; keep: road px
of the still kept below the pivot (the rest is hidden by the front layer at every lean and never packed). mirror: the left
facing frames draw the same picture mirrored (the figures have no lettering).
